description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Trapjaw Kelpie.
When Trapjaw Kelpie dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trapjaw Kelpie.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
